I think they're unavoidable though, since the main purpose of these property descriptions is to show up in an inspector tooltip:

body:
> Changing the values to an enum and moving the full descriptions to the enum would mean that you have to open the docs and navigate away from the importer to see the descriptions of what each item does. Oh well.

[We have something that handles this in the inspector](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/76238), but not in the import options, export options, project settings or editor settings yet.

The `normal_map_invert_y` flag could theoretically be marked as deprecated in the docs, since it can now be accomplished by setting the green channel remap to inverted green.
It's unclear from user perspective whether `normal_map_invert_y` happens before or after channel remapping, so ideally user should only use one or the other but not both at once. So deprecation warning could help nudging user towards this.

Removing the property seems more difficult due to versioning and compatibility, so that might have to wait for 5.0...

What do you think?
Indeed, I think it makes sense to deprecate it and point to the channel remapping options.
